posts.name: MCP Connectors by Databox
posts.tagline: Give your AI Analyst context to explain performance and act
posts.description: Connect your AI Analyst to the tools your business runs on. It pulls context from your CRM or support desk, so every answer reflects what's happening in your business, and it can act on what it finds. Choose from 10+ connectors or add any MCP server.

posts.name: Statable Analytics
posts.tagline: Web analytics built for you and your AI agents
posts.description: Statable is web analytics built for humans and AI agents. Use the simple dashboard yourself, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, and other agents through MCP to read reports, analyze traffic, and configure tracking, goals, and funnels. No cookies, no analytics consent banner in most cases, and your data stays hosted in the EU.

posts.name: SaleSmartly
posts.tagline: Turn conversations across every channel into customers
posts.description: SaleSmartly brings customer conversations from WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok, Telegram, LINE, WeChat and more into one workspace. Manage leads with a built-in CRM, let AI agents answer questions and qualify customers 24/7, translate conversations in real time, and automate follow-ups—all while your team keeps the context needed to turn more conversations into customers.

posts.name: VibeDefend by CybeDefend
posts.tagline: The one command line to secure your Cursor and Claude Code
posts.description: VibeDefend installs on your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Codex and more) with one command. From then on the agent writes with your business rules, mined from your repo, and your security rules in its context. It scans each diff while the file is still open, and a guard refuses rm -rf, sudo or a read of your secrets before it runs. Scanners check code after the commit, this runs before the line is written. Free plan, no card.

posts.name: Vitals 
posts.tagline: A Mac activity monitor that thinks in apps, not processes
posts.description: Activity Monitor lists a thousand processes, a hundred of them called Google Chrome Helper. Vitals adds every helper to the app that launched it, so you see 60 apps instead of 1,000 processes, each with one figure for memory, CPU, energy, disk and network. It keeps 30 days of history, alerts you when an app misbehaves, finds forgotten dev servers, and shows temperatures, fans and battery. Every readout can sit in your menu bar, arranged your way. Pay once. No subscription, no account.

posts.name: Okara
posts.tagline: The world's first AI CMO
posts.description: Okara is an AI CMO. Enter your website and it studies your product, competitors and brand voice, then runs 10+ agents for SEO, AI search, Reddit, X, LinkedIn, creators and UGC video. You approve every draft and it publishes. Used by 100,000+ businesses.

posts.name: GenCode
posts.tagline: A coding agent inside the Genspark Super App
posts.description: GenCode is Genspark’s coding agent with Chat and Terminal UIs. It supports models from Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more, and works directly on code in a directory you choose.

posts.name: Microsoft Copilot
posts.tagline: The Al built for work
posts.description: The new Copilot connects the tools people rely on with the next generation of capabilities they’ll need to build, customize and scale AI across work. Copilot connects with your work content and the apps you already use, bringing together the latest AI models to help you create finished work, not just answers.

posts.name: Shotcandy
posts.tagline: Make Your Screenshots Look Amazing
posts.description: Paste a screenshot. Get something lovely. Shotcandy is a free screenshot beautifier that turns plain screenshots into beautiful, share-ready images and videos in seconds, right in your browser.

posts.name: MuM
posts.tagline: A reading-first Markdown engine for macOS
posts.description: Your Markdown lives in a dozen folders. Most of the time you don't want to write — you just want to read one section. Every Markdown tool is a writing app with a preview pane. MuM is the opposite: a native macOS reader with no web engine inside — all AppKit. Several projects open at once, each remembering where you stopped. Cross-project search. Typesetting tuned for CJK as well as Latin. ~0.3s cold start, 1.7 MB download, 100+ fps scrolling a 5 MB document. Open source, MIT.

posts.name: Dina 4.5
posts.tagline: Beautiful screen recordings, screenshots, and 3D motion
posts.description: Record your screen, capture beautiful screenshots, add cinematic 3D motion and perspective, customize every detail, and share instantly with a link. Dina 4.5 brings screen recordings, screenshots, 3D animations, and sharing into one fast, beautifully designed workflow.

posts.name: Ryu Journal
posts.tagline: A journal to help busy minds let go
posts.description: Ryu means "flow" in Japanese. That's the whole idea. Ryu Journal is a quiet place to put a thought down and let it go. No accounts, no social feed, no pressure — just you and the page. Open it, write what's on your mind, and get back to your day. WRITE, THEN LET GO A clean, distraction-free editor. Tap the plus, write, save. Tap any entry to keep writing. Your week gathers softly into one simple timeline.

posts.name: Lattice
posts.tagline: Reshape your text across languages while preserving meaning
posts.description: Lattice reshapes your text through multiple language paths, creating a fresh expression while preserving the original idea.

posts.name: Stash
posts.tagline: Hidden controls for your Mac.
posts.description: Stash gives your Mac hidden controls that feel like they’ve always belonged there. Beautiful, native-feeling and ridiculously satisfying to use - adjust system controls with tactile sliders and dials, manage windows, and keep your favourite apps within reach through a hidden expandable dock and app launcher. Stash Deck extends the experience to your iPhone, turning it into a tactile remote for your Mac with quick controls, app launching and configurable widgets.

posts.name: Harness Router
posts.tagline: Fast AI tool routing powered by Jev.
posts.description: Harness Router is a decision layer for AI coding agents that makes tool selection faster, cheaper, and more reliable before execution. Use it as a Codex hook to automatically route every tool call, or as a skill when the agent should invoke routing explicitly. Obvious decisions stay on the fast path, ambiguous choices are resolved with Jev, and complex multi-step decisions can escalate to MCTS.

posts.name: vantage.ai
posts.tagline: See and control what your coding agent does.
posts.description: Vantage is a free, open-source cost and usage monitor, guardrail and session log for coding agents.

posts.name: Zerg Router
posts.tagline: Run DeepSeek in Codex
posts.description: One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for all your coding agents. The routing policy lives in your account, not inside each tool. • Run DeepSeek 4.1 Flash (or other models) inside Codex, and keep your workflow • Give every API key its own daily budget, enforced per request • Explicit fallbacks: on a 5xx, 429 or timeout, try your next model • See remaining weekly quota and reset dates across Codex accounts Supports paid usage, or bring your own provider keys.

posts.name: Sayble
posts.tagline: AI copilot for calls that tells you what to say next
posts.description: Sayble is a real-time AI copilot for sales calls, client meetings and negotiations. It hears what the other person just said and gives you one clear line to say next, plus a backup, in about half a second. When the call ends, it writes the recap and a ready-to-send follow-up email. Works on Zoom, Meet, Teams and phone calls. Mac & Windows, 10 languages.

posts.name: Arc
posts.tagline: Your mobile AI assistant on any screen
posts.description: Arc is a free AI assistant that works on whatever screen you're already on. You don't have to copy text into a chatbot. Call Arc up over any app and it reads the screen for you. • Summarize articles, chats, emails and docs instantly • Listen: have any screen read aloud • Rewrite replies and messages in the right tone, right where you type • Automate repetitive steps across apps Available on Android and Mac. Free to start.

posts.name: FaveNest
posts.tagline: Bookmarks that organize themselves with Apple Intelligence
posts.description: FaveNest is a visual library for the links, notes, screenshots, PDFs, and places you save. Share from any app or click the heart in Safari, and Apple Intelligence writes the title, summary, and tags on your device, so nothing you save is sent off to be read. No account, no FaveNest server: your library syncs through your own iCloud. Native on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Saving, sync, search, and export are free; Pro (7-day free trial) adds the AI, on device or with your own OpenAI or Anthropic key.

posts.name: Mochi
posts.tagline: A cute Mac desktop pet that organizes your loose files
posts.description: Mochi is a little pink blob who lives on your Mac. It floats around, naps, teases you about late nights and carries loose Desktop files into folders (never deletes, undo any move). Pro adds a tiny life sim: a strawberry tree, a nest and a family to raise.

posts.name: PIP
posts.tagline: AI buddy on your computer
posts.description: Pip is an AI buddy for your Mac. It sees your screen, talks you through it, and points at exactly where to click, even when it takes several clicks.

posts.name: Accessibility Checker by WebYes
posts.tagline: Check any webpage for Accessibility issues, right in Chrome
posts.description: Accessibility Checker by WebYes is a free Chrome extension for testing webpages against WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2, with support for ADA, EAA, and Section 508 requirements. Scan a page, review issues by severity, inspect affected elements and code, and go beyond automated checks with tools for color contrast, focus order, alt text, headings, and landmarks. Explore different user experiences with disability simulators and export detailed reports to share with your team.

posts.name: DOFOTT
posts.tagline: Meetings need time. Getting there does too.
posts.description: DOFOTT adds travel time to Google Calendar: a block before and after every event with a place, with real Google Maps durations. Shows up in Notion Calendar, Apple, Akiflow and more. Private: reads only time and place. No titles, no attendees, no tracking cookies. Fair: 12 meetings a month free. Busy month? $5, then unlimited. Quiet month, $0. Public: our numbers are live at dofott.com/built-in-public.

posts.name: FramioCam
posts.tagline: Screenshot & screen recording studio for Chrome
posts.description: FramioCam is a screenshot and screen recording studio built for people who explain things on screen. Capture a tab, window, full page, selected area, or your entire screen. Then edit it with annotations, backgrounds, device frames, zooms, cursor effects, webcam, transitions, and a real video timeline. Export polished screenshots and videos without switching between multiple tools. Your captures are processed locally on your device.

posts.name: Montty
posts.tagline: AI Finance teammate for your business
posts.description: Montty is an autonomous financial operating system designed to replace traditional bookkeeping and reactive financial analysis with an end-to-end AI brain. By automating the heavy lifting of data entry and transaction categorization, Montty frees founders from manual screen-tapping and human errors.

posts.name: Nook
posts.tagline: A quiet Mac browser that shows the article, not the clutter
posts.description: You open a page to read one article and get a cookie banner, a video that starts on its own, and a prompt to sign in. Nook shows the article. Ads and trackers are blocked from the first page you open, reader mode keeps the text and pictures, and focus mode hides the tabs and toolbar. Cookies and cache are cleared when you quit. No account, no sync, no telemetry. macOS 13+, Apple silicon and Intel. Free.

posts.name: QuickThrottle - Local content factory
posts.tagline: Viral TikTok slideshows and reels, driven from Claude Code
posts.description: A local app you drive from Claude Code. Your agent writes hooks from your product facts and Quick Throttle burns each one onto the same clip, so one clip becomes 12 reels. It builds TikTok slideshows too and sends videos straight to your TikTok drafts.

posts.name: Nowly
posts.tagline: Share what you do.
posts.description: Nowly automatically shows what you are doing online in your Discord Rich Presence status. With a browser extension, it detects what you watch, listen to, or browse, and shares it in real time with your Discord friends: title, channel, progress, and clickable buttons.

posts.name: Empryo
posts.tagline: The coding agent that knows your code by heart
posts.description: Code has structure. Empryo maps symbols, callers and dependencies, then edits code by symbol instead of relying only on text replacement. Review diffs and plans, keep project decisions across sessions, and choose a model for each job. Desktop GUI, terminal TUI and headless CLI on macOS, Linux and Windows.

posts.name: Fold
posts.tagline: Send messages at the speed of a paper airplane
posts.description: Every other messaging app races to deliver instantly. Fold does the opposite on purpose: you fold your note into a paper airplane and throw it across a real map, and it takes real-world time to arrive. The time is shaped by the actual distance between you and your friend, the plane you chose, and the live wind along its route. A message to someone across town might land in minutes. One to the other side of the planet can take days or weeks. You can open the map and watch it fly.

posts.name: Storytime
posts.tagline: Just talk, let Storytime create.
posts.description: Hit record and just talk, or start from anything: a PDF, a website link, an article, a prompt. In seconds Storytime makes the final edit: stumbles cut, captions, visuals, music. Use your own uploads, stock or AI visuals, or go faceless.

posts.name: Peersheep
posts.tagline: Peersheep watches your competitors

posts.description: Most cold email gets opens and no replies, right target, wrong timing. posts.description: A Chrome extension that gives you one daily time budget across X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and Substack. Post something original on X and you earn minutes back: consuming burns your budget, creating refills it. Everything stays in your browser, no servers and no tracking. Free for 7 days, then $6.99 a year (one San Francisco latte).

It runs on your own computer, and you pay once instead of monthly.

posts.description: Botly reads your website, learns your business and answers every visitor 24/7 in their own language. Add one line of code or install the WordPress plugin and it's live in minutes. For WooCommerce stores, Order Desk lets customers track orders, resend downloads, get invoices and raise support or refund requests on their own. Also: WhatsApp, multiple AI providers, custom styling and a free plan. Already live on DealMirror and Hostverge.

posts.name: Hotspotfly
posts.tagline: Run your MikroTik hotspot business from your phone
posts.description: HotspotFly turns your Android phone into a full MikroTik hotspot manager. Create internet packages at your own prices, print WiFi vouchers with QR codes, watch who's online, and see revenue by router and package as sales happen. Give each seller an agent code so commissions track themselves. Manage PPPoE subscribers too. No WinBox, no computer, no sign-up — your phone talks straight to your router, works offline, and your data never leaves your device. Free to start with one router.

posts.name: Encadra
posts.tagline: See the final frame before you shoot. No more cropping.
posts.description: Every marketplace has different photo ratios — 1:1, 4:5, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16. Encadra shows a white frame on your camera preview that matches the exact save area. Tap the shutter, and the photo inside the frame is saved as a finished JPEG. No cropping step. Built for resellers who photograph dozens of products daily on Depop, Poshmark, eBay, and Etsy. Free with a $6.99 lifetime Pro. Privacy-first: no account, no ads, on-device processing only.

posts.name: BreadcrumbAI
posts.tagline: Your customers are talking. We connect the dots.
posts.description: Enterprise-grade reputation management and crisis mitigation for hospitality businesses. A Big Brand Company product.

posts.name: TrackAPI
posts.tagline: Monitor API specs automatically
posts.description: TrackAPI is a tool for developers to easily monitor API specifications, with a simple interface and classified changes.

posts.name: AI Misuse & Training Audit
posts.tagline: Protect your content from AI training and misuse
posts.description: Find out how Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and other platforms may use your photos, videos, voice, and content for AI training. This free audit shows Creators which AI settings to check, where they can opt out or object, and what those settings don't protect on the open web. No signup required.

posts.name: Sentiqo
posts.tagline: What your customers say. What AI says back.
posts.description: Sentiqo gives a brand a 360° view of itself across the two channels that now decide its reputation — what real people say about you on Reddit, in app stores, on X, and across review sites, and what AI says when buyers ask ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini what to buy. We're the only platform that watches both, cuts through the noise, and flags the moment they diverge — in either direction.

posts.name: CryptoRisk Studio
posts.tagline: See the risk in your crypto — read-only, free
posts.description: CryptoRisk Studio shows how much risk is in your crypto portfolio: a 0–100 risk score where every point is explained, real crash replays (COVID, LUNA, FTX), liquidation distance for futures, a monthly-buy simulator and an AI analyst that only uses numbers the app calculated. It connects to Binance with a read-only key, or you type in your coins — it can never trade or withdraw. Runs on your computer (Windows & Mac); your keys never leave it.

posts.name: Image Color Palette Generator
posts.tagline: Extract colors from any image privately on your browser.
posts.description: The Colorsinspo Image Color Palette Generator turns any photo or screenshot into a practical, reusable color palette. Instead of guessing, it analyzes pixels to give you precise HEX, RGB, or HSL values. It combines three tools in one: a dominant color extractor, an exact color picker, and a palette editor. Perfect for studying visual balance, building website colors from a hero image, or preparing design tokens for development.

posts.name: Data2AIBot
posts.tagline: Build one AI agent for Instagram, WhatsApp & web
posts.description: Data2AIBot turns your business knowledge into one AI agent that works across Instagram, WhatsApp Business, and website chat. No need to build and manage separate bots for every channel. Automate repetitive questions, reply faster, and hand conversations to a human when needed. Sensitive customer data such as names, emails, phone numbers, and addresses is masked before AI processing for more privacy-conscious automation.

posts.name: Stocfore
posts.tagline: Inventory intelligence for growing businesses
posts.description: Stop guessing what to order. Stocfore analyzes your sales data and tells you exactly what to reorder, when, and how much.

posts.name: UpControl.io
posts.tagline: 1 click Status page + 1 prompt telemetry
posts.description: A public status page in one click, and the logging your coding agent adds with one npx package and any command you give it. Self-hosting is free.

posts.name: Qurioh
posts.tagline: Field notes for a curious life
posts.description: Photograph anything that catches your eye — a monument, a plant, or a stranger’s kitchen artifact — and Qurioh identifies it and writes a short, engaging story that you’ll actually want to read again. It also notifies you about the things you found curious but didn’t get a chance to look up.

posts.name: ModelNap
posts.tagline: Your local AI, on only when you use it
posts.description: Free, open source menu bar app that turns Ollama and Splash on and off in one click and unloads idle models from memory. It stops Ollama the way it started (Ollama.app, brew services or ollama serve). No accounts, no telemetry. macOS 14+.

posts.name: Whilely
posts.tagline: AI is thinking. You don't have to. Go meet a real human.
posts.description: Whilely is a Mac and Windows app that turns the time you spend waiting on AI into a short human break. When Claude Code, Cursor or Codex starts thinking, a small notch drops down and puts you on a live 1:1 video call with another developer who's waiting too. When your agent finishes, the notch goes away and you get back to work.

posts.name: Eexi AI
posts.tagline: Describe it. Get a live web app with login and a database.
posts.description: Describe the app you need in your own words, like a booking tool or a client portal, and Eexi builds the whole thing: pages, database, sign-in, file uploads and hosting. It's all built in, so there's nothing to connect or set up. Change anything in the visual editor without touching code. Publish in one click and connect your own domain. There's no monthly fee. You only pay for what you build.

posts.name: Masker — Keep Your Real Identity Private
posts.tagline: Anonymous email aliases and tracker blocking for the web.
posts.description: Masker is a privacy toolkit that helps you create anonymous email aliases, mask your phone number, and stop invisible email trackers before they load. What Masker does: - Anonymous email aliases — sign up for websites without exposing your real inbox. - Phone masking — keep your personal number private. - Tracker Shield — blocks invisible email tracking pixels before emails reach you. - Breach monitoring — get alerted if your email appears in known data breaches.

posts.name: Selvedge
posts.tagline: Remember the approaches your coding agent already rejected
posts.description: Your coding agent can read the code and still miss why you rejected an earlier approach. Selvedge preserves that context: explicitly record decisions, rejected paths, reasons, and when to reconsider them; retrieve the history through MCP or a Python CLI before trying again. Records live in local SQLite. MIT-licensed, no account, and no LLM calls by Selvedge. Try the built-in demo in a temporary database, then connect it to your coding workflow.

posts.name: DepCart
posts.tagline: No leaving of IDE and switching tabs more for packages.
posts.description: Free VS Code extension to search packages on npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist, pub.dev and Hex, pick versions and get the right install command.

posts.name: GrantSmart
posts.tagline: The all-in-one AI solution for managing your EU projects.
posts.description: GrantSmart.ai automates timesheets, tasks, budgets and reporting for EU-funded projects — so your team spends less time on admin and more time on the actual work. Upload your Grant Agreement and get an audit-ready workspace in minutes.

posts.name: footage.repair
posts.tagline: Recover interrupted camera footage — no upload needed
posts.description: Battery died mid-take or the card got pulled? The footage is still there — it just never got the index that tells a player where the frames are. footage.repair rebuilds that index entirely in your browser and hands back a normal, playable file. Nothing uploads, ever — a 100GB file would take longer to upload than it took to film. Free preview first, so you know it worked before paying. Supports Sony XAVC-S/XAVC-HS, Panasonicmdt, and DJI Osmo Action.

posts.name: Sorry, Not Invited
posts.tagline: Rank your wedding guest list without the fights
posts.description: Not everyone can come. That's okay. You and your partner each rate every guest in private, and the algorithm draws the line at your venue's capacity, so the hard calls never come down to one of you. - Import from The Knot, Zola or any spreadsheet - Several ratings per guest, weighted by what matters to you two - Plus-ones and kids count as seats; couples make or miss the cut together - Free to rate, $9.99 once to reveal who made the cut

posts.name: Quest.Dog Fresh walk ideas for your dog
posts.tagline: Turn every dog walk into a new adventure
posts.description: Most dog apps track distance or teach commands at home. Quest.Dog is about variety: a fog-of-war map clears as you walk, showing where you and your dog have never been. Real places nearby come with small quests (paws in a fountain, recall on a busy square) across 7 families like Water, City and Weather, so your dog gets a balanced life, not the same loop. Premium plans loops through unexplored areas. Built solo in Switzerland with my dog Jaina. Live on iPhone in 19 countries.

posts.name: Userflo
posts.tagline: Turn customer feedback into repeat purchases
posts.description: Userflo helps you collect feedback through beautiful, fully branded forms people actually enjoy filling. AI summarizes every response so you spot patterns in seconds — with every raw response one click away, so nuance never gets flattened. Built-in promotions let you show offers, ads, and new products to respondents when they're most engaged, turning feedback into repeat purchases.

posts.name: spFlat!
posts.tagline: Effortless SPF Flattening & Automatic Management
posts.description: Prevent PermError and bypass the SPF 10-lookup limit automatically. Continuous 24/7 IP monitoring & 1-click DNS updates. Test your domain for free today!

posts.name: Milometry
posts.tagline: Automatic mileage log. Pay once, no account, no cloud.
posts.description: Milometry notices when you drive, records the route, and lets you swipe each trip into business or personal. It adds them up at your country's official mileage rate: rules for 12 countries are built in (IRS, HMRC, CRA, ATO and more), or set your own or your employer's. Real fuel economy from your fill-ups, receipts for parking and tolls, monthly statements, CSV and PDF export. One payment, no subscription, no account, no analytics. The log never leaves your phone. iOS and Android, 6 languages.
